verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler has a dedicated Data Privacy, Security, Safety & Risk Management practice page claiming to have helped hundreds of companies embed privacy and security into infrastructure, but the evidence lacks specific mention of GDPR, CCPA, DPDP Act, or other named regulatory frameworks, and no client examples or detailed service breakdown are provided. Missing for 10: explicit regulatory framework coverage (GDPR/CCPA/DPDP), named case studies or client counseling examples, breadth of jurisdictional compliance services documented.
